EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for your interest in the English MA program at ASU!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for expressing interest in the English MA program at Arizona State University. This is a comprehensive degree program for students who desire a multifaceted understanding of the English language: its literatures; its linguistic, social and cultural histories and its capacities for persuasion, exposition and elucidation. Building on the strengths of a faculty with expertise in literary studies, rhetorical studies, composition and linguistics, the program allows students to delve into particular subject areas while also working across the range of sub-disciplines within English. For more information about the program feel free to review the MAENG Program Handbook. https://newcollege.asu.edu/sites/default/files/files/advising/documents/maeng_graduate_handbook_2015-16.pdf
Be sure to review our application checklist here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B44BICxe1BtdUWdQOXQ3ZzRMQk0/view?usp=sharing for more information about the application process in an easy to follow format, and peruse our sample schedule at this address: https://drive.google.com/open?id=0B91ycyfLEFl7azhyZnFuZXRsMUU to explore the flexible curriculum available for both full-time and part-time students. Also, please take a moment to check out our new e-magazine on our site and see all the exciting work being done by our faculty and students.
It's important to find the right fit in graduate school. A great way to learn more about this degree is to register for one of our upcoming information sessions. You can view the dates on our website, email me to RSVP for any date you plan to attend.
Kindest Regards, Graduate Studies
New College of Interdisciplinary Arts and Sciences Arizona State University, West campus nc.gradstudies@asu.edu
